implementation.uapi: Added AGI_LC_ACCEL_ACCOUNT_STATUS_TELEMETRY_LOST=4 without changing the ABI number.
implementation.overflow_admission: Rejected compute, non-release memory, and submission additions that would exceed U64_MAX before mutating device or FAISAL task counters; copy-back status is fail-closed and ioctl returns EOVERFLOW.
implementation.telemetry_ordering: Accelerator accounting publishes its event before releasing the accelerator mutex; a publication failure changes the returned status to TELEMETRY_LOST and returns the publication error after copy-back.
implementation.ring_backpressure: The full non-world event ring now returns EAGAIN regardless of whether sequence_out is supplied, allowing callers to observe loss rather than receiving a false success.
implementation.selftest: Tenant selftest subscribes to accelerator events, drains pre-existing records, fills the 64-entry ring, asserts EAGAIN and TELEMETRY_LOST on the 65th account, and unsubscribes.
implementation.commit: FAISAL accelerator: overflow-safe accounting and telemetry-loss reporting

release_gate.reason: M154 evidence is unsigned development evidence; operator-controlled release signing, stable/LTS forward-port qualification, independent build-farm qualification, physical accelerator qualification, and external security governance remain required.
release_gate.hardware_claim: No physical GPU, NPU, VRAM, IOMMU, DMA, vendor-driver, reset, or fleet qualification is claimed.

known_limitations: Validation uses QEMU and provider-neutral software accounting; it is not physical accelerator qualification.
The M154 kernel is built from the Linux v7.2-rc7 development line and has not completed stable or LTS forward-port requalification.
This incremental build is reproducible only within the recorded build directory; independent physical builders and operator-controlled signatures remain absent.
Durable execution regression passed, but this milestone does not claim new durable-execution functionality.
The evidence file is unsigned because no operator-controlled production signing key was supplied.
